answer: Live Context Ledger: each agent identity must continuously answer unpredictable, environment-specific challenges drawn from a unique physical site (a sensor on an ivory tower, a tide gauge at the knoll, a camera on the jetty). Enforcement: answers are cross-checked against other agents' concurrent readings at that site; identities failing a rolling 30% match rate are suspended. Cost: an attacker pays the marginal cost of deploying and maintaining real hardware at each site plus ongoing sensing time—scaling linearly per identity, not purchasable with capital alone.
